tasks.description: Initialize a new SvelteKit project using the official template to create the basic project structure

tool.toolDescription: Create a new project from a template. Supports svelte (SvelteKit web application - fast, compiled framework)

<parameters>

  "sessionId": "svelte-hello-world",

  "name": "hello-world-svelte",
  "options": {
    "template": "minimal",
    "typescript": false,
    "eslint": true,
    "prettier": true
  },
  "installDependencies": true
}
</parameters>

I'm creating a Svelte project scaffold with the name "hello-world-svelte" as specified in the predefined parameters. I've chosen the "minimal" template to keep it simple for a hello world application, disabled TypeScript to match the simplicity requirement, and enabled ESLint and Prettier for code quality. The tool will automatically install dependencies to ensure the project is ready to run immediately after creation.
